reuse.why: Uses the tree's recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, isDroppedWeekendOccurrence, skipsWeekendOccurrences and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but repeats the 'move the date when weekend handling applies' ternary instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The skipWeekend && !skipsWeekendOccurrences ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend : date ternary is copied from getUpcomingDates (it also appears in shared/schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts); everything else is new range logic.

placement.why: The handler lives in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates and is registered in SchedulesHandlers and app.method like its sibling.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Clear, typed and well documented (padding constant explained), with one more copy of the weekend-move ternary to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend dropping and moving go through the shared helpers from shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied weekend-move ternary in getDatesInRange is a verbatim copy of the one in getUpcomingDates, not disguised.
